text: - **P1. A verifier's first recorded act is provenance: the copy's HEAD and one copy-only line quoted in its report, before any check counts** (new). [1]

text: - **P2. The planted copy is handed over by allowlist, not by fence: the verifier's world is the copy plus named evidence paths; the real branch should be made unreachable where the harness allows (separate clone, detached export, no ref to the real tip), not merely forbidden** (new; the strong form of round 6's reference-copy note). [1]

group: ParcelRound — the verifier and the copy.
text: - **P3. Plant sets include metadata shapes — labels, counts-of-counts, provenance fields — and verifier briefs require per-field checks, never counts against an expected list** (extension). [2]

group: ParcelRound — the verifier and the copy.
text: - **P4. Any change after the copy is built — a verifier-finding fix included — goes past an independent delta check scoped to the diff before merge; "the verifier already saw the parcel" never covers bytes it did not see** (new). [3]

- **P5. Lead landing edits (tallies, restatements, record entries) are made by script with occurrence-count asserts and a recount before writing, and the adherence audit that grades the lead/parcel distinction runs at each wave close, not once at the end** (extension). [4, 10]

- **P6. The report artifact is a file in the agent's scratch; the result channel carries a compact summary and the path. A result that arrives spilled, truncated or empty is recovered from the file, never re-run for its text** (new, harness-facing). [5]

- **P7. A dead or voided attempt is named as such in the record; its tree and outputs are untrusted; the retry starts from a clean checkout and the grades come from the valid attempt only** (new). [1, 6]

- **P8. Every brief carries resource ceilings by default (memory, wall clock, process count), long parcels checkpoint progress the lead can read without asking, and an agent owns every process it starts until it kills or hands it over by name** (extension of time-boxes). [7]

- **P9. An authority is recorded with its execution mode — executed in the gate, executed at generation, or historical — and prose may claim only the weakest mode still true; a claim-vs-mechanism pass ("does the gate do what this sentence says, today?") is a named step at each seal, not an elective audit** (extension of §1/§9's spirit). [8]

- **P10. Load-bearing literals (hashes, counts, totals) live in a claim registry naming every surface that carries them; a restamp runs the registry, and generated surfaces (site data, docs tables) are entries in it, not exceptions** (extension of single-sourcing to prose). [9]

- **P11. A generated file's provenance stamp names the newest commit its contents were counted from; if the landing that commits it also appends counted rows, regeneration happens after the append or the stamp says which rows it excludes** (new). [10]

label_text: reinforcement of the front-door rule, extended to evidence paths
text: - **P12. Evidence is produced by the committed path. If a measurement needs a scratch variant, the variant is promoted into the tree (or the claim is scoped to the scratch path in the record) in the same parcel that first needs it** (reinforcement of the front-door rule, extended to evidence paths). [11]

label_text: adoption of round 6's clause, which this round skipped and paid for
text: - **P13. Every dispatch defines its roots (`<repos>`, `<scratch>`, `<ledger>`) and kit scripts resolve the workspace from any worktree, not from the main checkout's layout** (adoption of round 6's clause, which this round skipped and paid for). [12]

- **P14. The freeze recipe ends by running the consumer's exact verification command on the target shell (here: literal `sha256sum -c` under Git Bash), writes manifests LF, and builds the bundle from an allowlist; a bundle that only verifies under a tolerant reader is not frozen** (extension). [13]

- **P15. A hardware annex: environment inventory before first flash (serials, variants, cables proven by data not by charging), target by serial always, and a lock that is atomic (`mkdir`), carries pid/host/ time, and has a named stale-recovery** (new). [14]

label_text: reinforcement — adopted mid-round here after the owner's correction; should be the starting rule
text: - **P16. Metrics rows append at merge time (same step as the ledger entry), so no end-of-round refresh parcel exists and no cutoff needs a paragraph to interpret** (reinforcement — adopted mid-round here after the owner's correction; should be the starting rule). [15]

- **P17. An asset-provenance file beside the clean-room file: every non-code asset (music, images, fonts, data) names its source, licence and permitted surfaces before it enters a deliverable; unresolved rights default to the posture we improvised — ship silent, host elsewhere, never commit the raw asset** (new). [16]
